name: Question 15
problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that  

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 6\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ -5 & -2 & -4 \\ 6 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ -5 & -2 & -4 \\ 6 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{5}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 6 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 0 & -8 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=2 \\ 8{x}_{2}=1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=\frac{1}{8}.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain

$$
2{x}_{1}+4\cdot \frac{1}{8}=2\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=\frac{3}{4}.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{4} \\ \frac{1}{8}\end{aligned}].$ 

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{8}=\frac{7}{8}.$

Question 15
?

Find the coordinates of the vector x relative to the basis B={b1,b2}, where b1=[2−56],b2=[4−24],x=[2−45].

If [x]B=[x1x2] then what is the value of x1+x2?

a
54
b
1
c
78
d
x∉span{b1,b2}
e
−7
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We need to find x1 and x2 such that

x1b1+x2b2=xx1[2−56]+x2[4−24]=[2−45].

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

M=[242−5−2−4645].

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following: M=[242−5−2−4645]R2:=R2+52R1∼[242081645]R3:=R3+(−3)R1∼[2420810−8−1]R3:=R3+R2∼[242081000]

The system is now {2x1+4x2=28x2=1.

From the second equation, we get x2=18. Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain

2x1+4⋅18=2⟹x1=34.

Therefore, [x]B=[3418].

Finally, x1+x2=34+18=78.
